text:
ava: Heads-up — spotted ~24 DB snapshot objects in prod-bucket missing SSE-KMS metadata during the nightly backup audit. looks like they were uploaded without ServerSideEncryption header. anyone seen this?

raj: Yikes. Are these from backup-agent or manual uploads?

lexi: Checking agent logs now. backup-agent v2.3.1 ran at 02:10 and 03:10 UTC. logs show PutObject success but no x-amz-server-side-encryption header captured in the head-object calls.

mike: Tagging oncall: @oncall-bot can you correlate deploys/config changes around 01:50-04:00 UTC? any policy/role changes?

oncall-bot: Deploybot: config-change by ops_jane at 01:58 UTC — "s3:PutObject policy update" (PR #4122). Rolling deploy completed 02:05 UTC. No automated rollback.

ava: PR #4122 moved backup-agent role attach to the new role-permissions service. suspect a race/failure during attach where agent couldn't fetch CMK permissions and fell back to upload without encryption. unclear yet.

lexi: Found error in agent logs: "WARN: failed to retrieve cmk-kv from kms: AccessDenied" then agent continues and uploads without setting SSE header. snippet: \n```\n2026-03-20T02:09:58Z WARN backup-agent s3_uploader.go:182 failed to get CMK: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform kms:Encrypt on key arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc\n```\n
ava: That matches. So agent behavior is: on KMS error it proceeds but omits ServerSideEncryption. We need to treat existing objects as potentially exposed. Which tenants are affected?

lexi: I ran: `aws s3api list-objects --bucket prod-backups --prefix db/2026-03-20 --query 'Contents[].Key'` and inspected HeadObject for a sample. Missing 'ServerSideEncryption' on keys like: `db/tenant42/backup-20260320.snap` and `db/tenant99/backup-20260320.snap`.

mike: Impact: Confidentiality risk for those snapshots. Immediate containment steps: 1) enumerate all objects lacking SSE-KMS, 2) quarantine / copy them to an encrypted prefix, 3) add SIEM rule to flag GetObject on those keys, 4) notify legal/security if customer data exposed. Who can run a full scan?

ava: I'll run the scan now and produce CSV of keys + sizes + host that uploaded them. ETA ~30m. Assigned to me.

raj: I'll open an incident ticket (P1-medium scope) and assign triage. Also propose reverting PR #4122 until we confirm policy-attach service reliability.

lexi: Reproduce locally: when agent gets KMS AccessDenied it logs warn and uploads without SSE header — quick hotfix is to make the agent fail-fast (abort upload) on KMS denies. I'll prepare a hotfix branch.

mike: Also add alerting: metric for backup uploads where HeadObject.ServerSideEncryption is missing and rate > 0. I'll add a Grafana alert and PagerDuty rule.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260320-0042. Severity: Medium. Channel: #incidents. Pager rotated.

ava: CSV done and attached to ticket: 24 objects across 3 tenant prefixes. Hostnames where agent ran: backup-wn-12, backup-wn-13, backup-wn-14.

raj: Containment plan proposals: a) copy affected keys to `quarantine/` prefix with `--sse aws:kms`, b) temporarily block read access to those prefixes, c) force agent to fail on KMS denies and roll out hotfix.

lexi: Copy command example (starting small): \n```\naws s3 cp s3://prod-backups/db/tenant42/backup-20260320.snap s3://prod-backups/db/tenant42/quarantine/backup-20260320.snap --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc\n```\nI'll start copies for the smallest objects first to validate.

mike: Approved. Also pull S3 access logs and run SIEM query: `eventName = "GetObject" AND (requestParameters.key IN <affected-keys>)` to detect any reads since 02:00 UTC.

ava: Started copies for 10 small snapshots. Notifying CSM/legal for affected tenants to prepare disclosure if required.

raj: Postmortem action items (initial):
- backup-agent: fail-fast on KMS denies + clear telemetry event (lexi)
- deploy tooling: assert policy attach success before switching roles (ops)
- monitoring: alert for missing SSE on uploads (mike)
- backfill: copy/quarantine all unencrypted objects (lexi/ava)
- runbook: add steps for encryption-missed uploads (security)

lexi: Hotfix PR prepared to abort uploads on KMS AccessDenied and emit `encryption.missed` metric. Requesting review.

mike: I'll coordinate rollback of PR #4122 with ops_jane and timeline. Ops_jane: please provide when role-permissions service returned 403s.

ava: Quick note — we also need to rotate any CMKs *only if* we detect unauthorized access. Not doing CMK rotation prematurely to avoid breaking restores.

raj: Agree. Keep CMK rotation as conditional after SIEM review.

lexi: Will push hotfix on `hotfix/encrypt-fail-fast` once reviewed. Also adding a unit/integration test to simulate KMS denies and ensure upload abort.

mike: Thanks all. I'll own the monitoring and incident comms. ava, lexi: keep ticket updated with CSV and copy progress. :thumbsup:

ava: On it. will update in 20m.

lexi: Starting copy job now.

mike: Good work team. We'll reconvene in 1 hour for status.
